race.title: carpetgallop.co.uk Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: TITANIUM RING ticks plenty of boxes and can make it a worthwhile journey for the Henry Daly team. Recent C&D winner Kool Raoul looks capable of another bold bid, while Bobby Socks makes each-way appeal at the forecast prices. TITANIUM RING (IRE) KOOL RAOUL (FR) BOBBY SOCKS
